summary: A 1970 change to the distribution list for MIT, which updates RFC 52. It is administrative.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 69 asks recipients to update their distribution lists by removing A. Bhushan and adding Albert Vezza. It gives Vezza's MIT contact information.

questions: who was added to the mit distribution list
subtitle: A short request to change the recipients on an MIT distribution list.

tldr.problem: A. Bhushan asks recipients to change the name on their distribution lists.
tldr.mechanism: The note asks readers to remove Bhushan and add Albert Vezza, and supplies Vezza's MIT address and telephone number.
tldr.outcome: RFC 69 is an administrative note that updates RFC 52.

facts.label: Distribution-list change
facts.value: Remove A. Bhushan; add Albert Vezza

today: RFC 69 updates RFC 52. The unit metadata lists no later RFC that updates or replaces it.

sections.title: The Distribution-List Request
sections.content: A. Bhushan asks readers to delete his name from their distribution lists and add Mr. Albert Vezza. The note is addressed to people who maintain those lists.
sections.plainLanguage: The note asks list recipients to remove Bhushan and add Vezza.

sections.title: Albert Vezza's Contact Information
sections.content: The note gives Albert Vezza's address at MIT: Room 831, Project MAC, 545 Technology Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts 02139. It also lists a telephone number and extension.
sections.plainLanguage: The note supplies the new contact's MIT address and telephone details.

sections.title: Relation to RFC 52
sections.content: RFC 69 is marked as updating RFC 52. Its text contains the distribution-list change and contact details, with no protocol definition.
sections.plainLanguage: This is an administrative update to the list in RFC 52, not a protocol specification.

references.text: RFC 52, an earlier note containing the distribution list.
